correction_reason: an empty prediction has central_hole_preservation=1 by construction, so strict improvement over FLOW_ONLY is impossible and the v1 gate is degenerate
prior_support_rule: B_RING oracle median IoU and median azimuthal ring coverage must both exceed paired FLOW_ONLY medians, and at least one oracle sample must have beta1=1 in the registered target crop
seismic_correction_rule: conditional on prior support, B_RING seismic median IoU and median azimuthal ring coverage must both exceed paired FLOW_ONLY medians and median hard seismic RMSE must decrease
